title: Positioning Singapore to be Global Centre for Data Storage and Services
what_it_is: Positioning Singapore to be Global Centre for Data Storage and Services

sections.label: Singapore data centres and cables
sections.summary: Singapore holds half of Southeast Asia's data centre capacity, and IMDA, EDB and JTC work to attract data centre and submarine cable investment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Cross-border data flows generate significant value and growth to economies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: According to Cushman and Wakefield's Data Center Risk Index, Singapore is the Asia Pacific region's most robust market for data centres.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Singapore holds half of Southeast Asia's data centre capacity and is a major Asia Pacific hub for submarine cables, with 19 cable systems connecting us directly to more than 33 countries.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Government agencies, such as the Info-communications Media Development Authority (IMDA) and the Economic Development Board (EDB) are working together to attract more investments in critical infrastructure, such as data centres and submarine cables.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: To strengthen our international connectivity, IMDA is doing more to facilitate the landing of major submarine cables in Singapore, while EDB is engaging global technology companies and leading data centre players to invest in data centres here.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: IMDA and EDB are also working with JTC to plan for sufficient land and power in data centre clusters to support quality data centre investments.

sections.label: Data trust and protection rules
sections.summary: A Data Protection Trustmark certification scheme is being rolled out and the Personal Data Protection Act is under review.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In turn, this trust facilitates and enables more innovative uses of data by companies and allows society to derive greater benefits from the responsible use of data.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: This is why we are working on rolling out a Data Protection (DP) Trustmark certification scheme for companies that adopt best practices in managing personal data.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: We are also currently reviewing the Personal Data Protection Act to further develop our regulations to support our data ambitions.
